title: Fujifilm X100VI Review Roundup: Worth the Wait?
description: Volt’s research-based verdict on the Fujifilm X100VI: the image quality and film looks reviewers adore, plus the battery, card slot and availability catches.
intro: TikTok’s favourite camera is genuinely excellent according to reviewers. The hard part is buying one at a fair price.
verdict: A brilliant everyday camera. Just don’t pay a scalper for one.
pros: Classic, compact design that’s a joy to carry
cons: Hard to find, with long waiting lists at times
Single, slower UHS-I card slot for big files
bestFor: Enthusiasts who want one beautiful camera for everyday and travel photos.
skipIf: You need zoom or video features, or you’d have to pay over the odds to get one.
cardText: A brilliant everyday camera; just don’t pay scalper prices.

sections.h2: Why everyone is talking about it
sections.html: Its predecessor went viral on TikTok for film-like photos straight out of the camera, and the X100VI inherited that hype, with back orders reported by TechRadar.

DPReview scored it 87%, praising the stabilised 40MP sensor. TechRadar called it an everyday delight. Tom’s Guide liked the images but flagged the single UHS-I card slot. Battery life and the fixed lens are the recurring caveats.
The hype is deserved, the value depends on what you pay. Buy from authorised retailers or join official waiting lists. Alternatives are in our X100VI explainer.
